description: This file defines interfaces for a GstDispatcherThread and its factory within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace. It declares the IGstDispatcherThread class with deleted copy/move constructors and assignment operators, and the IGstDispatcherThreadFactory interface for creating GstDispatcherThread instances. It also includes external dependencies on IGstDispatcherThreadClient and IGstWrapper.

classes.name: IGstDispatcherThread
classes.description: Interface for a dispatcher thread handling GStreamer pipeline events, with non-copyable and non-movable semantics.

classes.name: IGstDispatcherThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating IGstDispatcherThread instances, requiring implementation of createGstDispatcherThread method.

methods.name: createGstDispatcherThread
methods.description: Creates a new IGstDispatcherThread instance given a client, pipeline, and IGstWrapper reference.
